versions.changelog:
Initial release of spraay-bankr skill.

- Adds integration to batch-pay up to 200 recipients from a Bankr agent wallet via Spraay, saving ~80% gas vs individual transfers.
- Supports airdrops, splitting creator/trading fees, USDC payroll, and ERC-20 batch distributions on Base.
- Ensures all payments are atomic: either all succeed or all revert.
- Built-in safety rails: always validate, estimate, and seek user confirmation before execution; never fabricate recipient data.
- Requires Bankr skill and Spraay gateway access; no separate API key needed for paid endpoints.
